notice.title: Legal notice
notice.content: monemploiGo is an online platform for building resumes and cover letters, primarily aimed at users across French- and English-speaking Africa. Prices are shown in CFA francs (FCFA). For any question, you can contact us via the address listed on the site.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data we collect, why, and how you can control it.
privacy.dataContent: We collect your name, email address and password (encrypted) when you create an account, as well as the content of the resumes and letters you create (including a photo, if you choose to add one). This information remains the property of the user. Your email address is also used to send you messages related to your account, such as the welcome email after registration; these messages are sent through Google's Gmail service. If you give us your review (rating and comment), it is used only to improve the service; it is not published on the site and it is deleted with your account. Retention period: a paid document is deleted automatically 3 weeks after payment, and a draft 3 weeks after its last edit (photo included). Only the payment history (amount, date, status), without the document's content, is kept for accounting purposes.
privacy.paymentContent: Payments are processed by our partners MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money. We never store your mobile payment credentials or codes.
privacy.cookiesContent: We use essential cookies (login session, language preference) and, with your consent, audience-measurement cookies. See our cookie policy for details.
privacy.rightsContent: You can view, change or delete your data at any time from your dashboard, including permanently deleting your account.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.content: By creating an account on monemploiGo, you agree to use the service fairly, provide accurate information, and not attempt to compromise the site's security. Purchased documents are for personal use. Any attempt to hack, intrude on, or fraudulently use the service will result in the account being suspended.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie policy
cookiePolicy.content: Essential cookies keep you logged in and remember your preferred language. They are required for the site to work and cannot be disabled. You can manage non-essential cookies via the banner shown on your first visit.

items.text: Paid documents: free re-download for 3 weeks, then automatic deletion. Keep a copy of your PDF.
Aim for one page: the editor's indicator tells you live whether your CV fits on one A4 page.
Need a Word file? Open your PDF with Microsoft Word (File > Open) to make it editable.
Tailor your CV to each job by reusing the keywords from the ad, especially for an ATS CV.
Drafts: deleted automatically after 3 weeks without edits.
No experience yet? Tick "I don't have work experience yet" and highlight internships, projects and education.
Applying in Germany: state your certified German level (B1, B2, telc…), it's the first thing recruiters check.
CV photo: recent, facing the camera, neutral background and professional outfit.
Proofread before paying: the live preview shows exactly the document you will download.

ats.title: Why choose an ATS resume?
ats.intro: An ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is recruitment software: it reads your resume, extracts your information and helps the recruiter sort applications. Many large companies, international organizations and online job platforms use one. A heavily designed resume (several columns, icons, charts) may be read incorrectly.

points.title: Read without errors
points.text: A single column, standard section titles and real text, with no icons or photo: the software finds every piece of information in its place.

points.title: Found through keywords
points.text: The software compares your resume with the job offer. Reuse the exact words from the ad (job title, skills, software) in your profile and experience.

points.title: Liked by recruiters
points.text: Clean and easy to scan, it also makes a good impression when a recruiter reads it, on screen or printed.

ats.whenTitle: Choose it if you are applying:
when: through a job website or an online form
to a large company or a multinational
to an international organization or an NGO

german.title: Why an ATS resume for Germany?
german.intro: In Germany, most applications are sent online: by email or through the employer's application portal. Large employers, including many hospital groups, sort applications with software (ATS). And recruiters expect a "Lebenslauf": a clear, structured, chronological resume.

points.title: Lebenslauf format
points.text: Section titles in German (Berufserfahrung, Ausbildung…) and the usual personal details: date and place of birth, nationality. Everything stays optional.

points.title: Read by screening software
points.text: A clean layout and real text: the recruiter's software reads your resume without errors.

points.title: Your German level stands out
points.text: State your certificate (B1, B2, telc B2 Pflege…): it's the first thing institutions check for an Ausbildung.

points.title: Optional photo
points.text: It is no longer mandatory in Germany but is still common. If you add one, choose a professional photo.
